question: A stakeholder wants Claude to answer questions about their company's internal product catalog, which was updated last week and was never part of Claude's training data. How should this limitation and solution be communicated?
options: A) Explain that the catalog only needs to be emailed to Anthropic once so it joins the base model going forward.
B) Explain that Claude cannot process proprietary data, so supplying the catalog via retrieval or a connected tool will not help.
C) Explain that Claude automatically indexes any company website within days, so no integration work is ever required.
D) Explain that Claude lacks internal data knowledge, so the catalog must be supplied via retrieval or a connected tool.
correct_answers: D) Explain that Claude lacks internal data knowledge, so the catalog must be supplied via retrieval or a connected tool.
explanations: Incorrect. Sending data to Anthropic does not add it to the base model’s training; to keep answers current with recent changes, retrieval-based or tool-based approaches must be used.

Incorrect. Claude can effectively process proprietary data when it is supplied in the prompt or via retrieval; the limitation is a lack of prior knowledge, not an inability to use supplied information.
Incorrect. Claude does not automatically crawl, index, or learn from any company website; integration work is always required to supply it with proprietary or recently updated data.
Correct. Claude lacks built-in knowledge of internal company data, so the updated product catalog must be provided through retrieval mechanisms like RAG or a connected tool for accurate answers.
